latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the characterization test writing skill for legacy code.

- Provides guidance for writing characterization (behavior-preserving) tests in untested legacy code before making changes.
- Describes when to use characterization tests, with triggers and scenarios outlined.
- Details a step-by-step process: choosing scope, setting up test harness, writing failing assertions to discover actual behavior, and updating tests accordingly.
- Integrates with related skills such as legacy-code-change-algorithm and change-effect-analysis.
- Targeted at developers needing a regression safety net during legacy code modification.
- Requires a codebase with an xUnit-style test framework for execution.
